question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution mentions that it shall be the duty of every citizen of India to have compassion for living creatures?
solution:
The correct answer is __**51 A (g)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 51A(g) of the Indian Constitution pertains to the fundamental duties of citizens.
 
• It explicitly mentions that it is the duty of every citizen of India to have compassion for living creatures.
 
• This article is part of the fundamental duties listed in Part IVA of the Constitution.
 
• The fundamental duties were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
 
• These duties are intended to serve as a constant reminder to citizens to promote a sense of discipline and commitment towards the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**:

 
 
• This amendment is also known as the "Mini-Constitution" due to its wide-ranging impact on the Constitution.
 
• It added ten fundamental duties to the Constitution under Article 51A.
 
 
 
• **Fundamental Duties**:
 
 
• Fundamental duties are non-justiciable, meaning they are not enforceable by the courts.
 
• They serve as moral obligations for citizens to promote patriotism and uphold the unity of India.
 
 
 
• **Part IVA of the Constitution**:
 
 
• This part was added by the 42nd Amendment Act and consists of only one article, Article 51A.
 
• It lists the fundamental duties of citizens towards the nation.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Compassion for Living Creatures**:
 
 
• Promotes humane treatment and welfare of animals.
 
• Encourages environmental conservation and biodiversity.
 
• Fosters a society that values and respects all forms of life.
